3cc5b7.title: Target Map: httpbin.org
3cc5b7.content:
- **Mode:** Black-box web application assessment
- **In-scope target:** `https://httpbin.org`
- **Initial plan:** Delegate bounded reconnaissance and endpoint mapping first, then assign specialized agents for high-value vectors based on discovered surfaces.
- **Priority vectors expected to be relevant:** input reflection, redirect handling, SSRF-like URL fetch behaviors if present, auth/basic-auth style endpoints, state-changing surfaces if any.
- **Root-agent constraint:** orchestration only; hands-on probing delegated to child agents.
